item.title: [MSFT Neutral (-0.11)] Defense supplier IEH Corporation discloses Microsoft 365 mailbox breach via phishing
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (-0.11)
US defense and aerospace supplier IEH Corporation has reported a security incident where a cybercriminal gained access to its Microsoft 365 mailbox through a phishing attack. An employee fell victim to a scam involving a fake Microsoft sharing link, leading to the capture of their credentials and unauthorized access to various sensitive documents. While IEH has secured the account and is implementing corrective actions, the exact duration of the compromise remains unknown, though no data exfiltration has been confirmed.

item.title: [AAPL Bearish (-0.24)] Apple settles EEOC claims about antisemitic retail manager for $150K
item.description:

The lawsuit alleged that a manager at a Reston, Virginia Apple store made antisemitic comments, forced a Jewish employee to work on the Sabbath, and fired him after he refused to work on a Friday. Apple denied wrongdoing in the case, which involved claims of religious discrimination and retaliation under Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964.
